Major Remodels in Clearwater, KS

A major remodel in Clearwater is a whole-home transformation — not a single room refresh, but a comprehensive renovation that addresses the accumulated deferred maintenance and outdated design of a home that's been in service for 40–70 years without significant renovation. In Clearwater's older housing stock, that's exactly what's needed in a lot of cases.

The original 1960s kitchen is at end of life. The bathrooms haven't been touched since they were built. The living room layout doesn't match how families live today. The electrical panel hasn't been updated. Rather than renovating room by room over a decade, a major remodel addresses everything in a single coordinated project — more efficient, more cohesive, and ultimately more cost-effective.

Wheatland Construction executes major remodels in Clearwater and south Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018.

What a Clearwater Major Remodel Typically Includes

Kitchen and bathroom renovation: Core spaces first — new kitchen layout, cabinets, countertops, appliances. Bathroom tile, vanities, fixtures. Everything coordinated across finishes.

Electrical and plumbing update: Clearwater's older homes may have panels and service that haven't kept up with modern load requirements. We address this during a major remodel while walls are already open.

Flooring replacement: Consistent new flooring throughout — LVP or hardwood in living areas, tile in wet areas.

Layout improvements: Opening closed layouts where structurally feasible. Load-bearing wall assessment and permits for structural changes.

Interior finish: New interior doors, trim, paint throughout. The cosmetic layer that ties the functional improvements together.

Clearwater-Specific Considerations

Ninnescah River moisture: South Sedgwick County homes near the river corridor can have moisture infiltration history at exterior walls. We assess during planning and address moisture barriers during the remodel rather than covering over existing problems.

Older construction assessment: Pre-1970s Clearwater homes need assessment for asbestos-containing materials before demo, galvanized pipe condition, and electrical service capacity. We handle this as part of the pre-project assessment phase.

Rural property permits: Sedgwick County Planning and Building for unincorporated properties. We handle all permitting and inspections.

How We Approach Major Remodeling in Clearwater

Major remodels involve more coordination than single-room projects - structural assessments, permit packages with engineered drawings where required, phased scheduling to keep portions of the home livable, and subcontractor coordination for specialized trades. We manage all of it.

We price in writing with full scope documentation before work starts. Change orders are documented and approved before work proceeds.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas.

In Clearwater, the Ninnescah River corridor and southern Sedgwick County rural character shape both the housing stock and the renovation context.

Frequently Asked Questions About Major Remodels in Clearwater

How much does a major remodel cost in Clearwater, KS?

Clearwater major remodels range from $80,000 for a targeted multi-room renovation to $250,000+ for a comprehensive whole-home transformation. Rural south Sedgwick County pricing. Written, line-item estimates.

Who handles permits for major remodeling in Clearwater?

Sedgwick County Planning and Building for unincorporated properties. City of Clearwater for homes inside city limits. We determine jurisdiction and handle all permits.

How long does a major remodel take in Clearwater?

4–10 months depending on scope. Larger whole-home projects with structural changes take toward the longer end.

Do you test for asbestos before demoing a pre-1970s Clearwater home?

Yes — pre-1978 construction may contain asbestos-containing materials (popcorn ceilings, floor tile adhesive, pipe insulation). We test before demo and remediate appropriately where found.

Can you do a major remodel while I'm living in the house?

Depends on scope. For whole-home projects, temporary relocation during active construction phases is usually practical and we discuss it at the planning stage. For phased renovations, we can often sequence to keep a portion of the home livable.

Does a major remodel add value in Clearwater?

Yes. A major remodel in Clearwater transforms an aging home into a fully updated property that trades at a premium over unrenovated comparable homes in the south Sedgwick County market.
